question: Should OpenClaw core adopt this opt-in durable runtime, twelve-table persistence model, and five read-only operator RPCs on the 2026.7.1 line?
rationale: Code review can assess the implementation, but it cannot decide whether this new persistent runtime and public control-plane contract belongs in core or what compatibility commitment the beta line should make.

options.title: Sponsor staged durable core
options.body: Approve the inspection-first core direction, require predecessor-stack landing order and exact upgrade proof, then complete owner review of the public and plugin SDK contracts.

options.title: Narrow to inspection delta
options.body: Land the durable foundation separately and rebase this PR into a small read-only Gateway, CLI, protocol, and documentation change.

options.title: Decline the core contract
options.body: Close or redesign the stack if maintainers do not want to own this durable persistence and public API surface in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged durable core
recommendation.body: Approve the inspection-first core direction, require predecessor-stack landing order and exact upgrade proof, then complete owner review of the public and plugin SDK contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to the adjacent core/plugin-runtime and plugin-SDK architecture affected by the decision.
